original_test_intent: Validate the Type 39 Power Unit Group of every possible system power supply, including zero/non-redundant and shared nonzero/redundant relationships, and confirm stable reporting after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 39 records, build a per-supply group map, compare it with the approved PSU topology and read-only inventory, enforce relationship semantics, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies topology/group expectations and approves reboot; no PSU removal, switching or physical stimulus is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected possible/installed PSU inventory and redundant-group membership
SMBIOS version and validated Type 39 parser
Approved read-only BMC/Redfish/IPMI inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Use only read-only SMBIOS and PSU inventory queries; never remove or switch a supply.
Evaluate every Type 39 record; a nonzero group must have a peer in the complete possible-supply set.
Distinguish absent/optional supplies from missing firmware records using approved topology.
Stop on power/management loss; do not auto-retry reboot or manipulate redundancy.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full raw/decoded Type 39, map every handle/supply to its group, validate zero/nonzero relationships, correlate read-only inventory and diff pre/post reboot.
Report singleton groups, inventory mismatch or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve PSU topology/group semantics, inventory source and reboot plan.
Interpret design exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but one grep cannot prove set-level group membership, peer count or topology consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive every raw/decoded Type 39 record; emit a handle/location/group table, zero/nonzero rule result, inventory correlation and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 39 scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no PSU manipulation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse all Type 39 records, enforce 00h for non-redundant units and peer membership for each nonzero group, correlate approved inventory and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 39 power-supply records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and inventory-interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Power Unit Group semantics plus platform PSU topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a scalar grep with complete relational validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects singleton nonzero groups, missing members, wrong group reuse and reboot drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved PSU topology and group policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only inventory may enumerate installed rather than all possible supplies; compare using the approved topology model.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define optional bays and group numbering, but must preserve group-zero/nonzero semantics and record whether validation covers possible or installed supplies.
expected_evidence: Approved PSU topology/group and optional-bay policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 39 records with handles, lengths and group map
Per-group peer counts and read-only inventory correlation
Statement that no PSU was removed/switched
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot diff

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project inputs, execution state and engineer verdict from automation capability.

review_improvement: Turns a formatted-line observation into an invariant over the entire power-supply record set without unsafe physical stimulus.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power Unit Group is meaningful only relationally: zero denotes no redundancy group, while a nonzero identifier needs at least one peer and approved topology correspondence.
